gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF.

datasetKey.description: Dataset identifier linking all records to the same GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each occurrence.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for the species, always Animalia.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for each record, always Chordata.

class.description: Class denotes the taxonomic class Teleostei for all records.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species is Perciformes.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the species, Tetrarogidae.

genus.description: Taxonomic rank above species, uniformly Gymnapistes.

species.description: Species name of the recorded fish, always Gymnapistes marmoratus.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Taxonomic subspecies identifier, currently missing for all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank for each occurrence, consistently recorded as species.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the species recorded, including author and year.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Gymnapistes marmoratus.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship data is entirely missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code identifying the nation where each occurrence was recorded, using ISO two‑letter format.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Australian state or territory where each Gymnapistes marmoratus occurrence was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation site.

individualCount.description: Individual count of observed specimens, currently unavailable in this dataset.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of occurrence in decimal degrees, ranging across Australian east coast.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates, expressed in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data is unavailable for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation of observation site in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy information is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth measurement not recorded for any occurrence.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth measurement accuracy, typically reported in meters.

eventDate.description: Date and time when each occurrence was recorded.

day.description: Day of month when the occurrence was recorded.

month.description: Observation month as integer from 1 (January) to 12 (December).

speciesKey.description: Uniform species identifier for Gymnapistes marmoratus records.

basisOfRecord.description: Human observation records the source type for each occurrence entry.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying iNaturalist as the data source for each occurrence record.

collectionCode.description: Collection code for all records, consistently set to Observations.

catalogNumber.description: Unique specimen identifier assigned by the collection database.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded or reported each occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

license.description: License specifying usage rights for each occurrence record, using standard Creative Commons categories.

rightsHolder.description: Individuals or groups credited with ownership of each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Gymnapistes marmoratus occurrence.

typeStatus.description: Taxonomic status classification, currently missing for all records.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means information is unavailable for all occurrence records.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of the most recent interpretation of each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type associated with each occurrence record, e.g., still image, video, audio.

issue.description: Data quality flags for coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifiers.

gymnapistes_marmoratus.description: Occurrence records of Gymnapistes marmoratus in Australia (1978‑2026) with coordinates, dates, observers, and media.

description: Occurrences of Gymnapistes marmoratus recorded from 1978 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
